title: Why I cant able to create charts from a report in frappe 15

posts.name: Sagar Patil
posts.cooked:
In previous version frappe 14 there were option to create chart from a report’s data but now in 15 there is no option to create chart, there is only option to create card.

Is there any another way to create chart with reports
I plan to build a dashboard from it that allows applying filters to each chart, consistent with the filters used in the reports.
